items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua doubtful/not expected Sunday vs Broncos (hip/groin); McVay expects Week 4 return barring setback. Adams carries load.
items.why: No practice; not making great progress.
items.implication: Adams WR1 with elevated routes/targets (42% target rate sans Nacua historically).
items.opportunity: Adams 8-195-2 prior miss; high aDOT concentration.

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels; Marcus Mariota starts. Longer-term positive news per Rapoport.
items.implication: Mariota start; McLaurin still viable but matchup-dependent.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins (hamstring) for Sunday at Indianapolis; second straight miss.
items.implication: Schultz primary beneficiary on targets/routes; Hutchinson/Noel secondary.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe); Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but coach says he will lead the group.
items.why: Toe injury; Warren to lead with breathers via backups.
items.implication: Warren full lead back; checkdown volume likely vs Bengals.

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) in. Clarity hoped on Flowers/Mitchell/Moore.
items.why: ETR projections assume play despite Q tags.

items.text: ETR projections live; Jahmyr Gibbs sets new record ceiling at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg). High workload vs Jets.
Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman (ankle) OUT.
items.implication: Committee returns; reverse prior Coleman beneficiaries.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren leads PIT RBs; vertical not working for Rodgers so expect checkdown spam. Projecting Warren (Q) in. Backups Homer/Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach: Warren leads; needs breathers. Usage opportunity.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + checkdowns; high snap share.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks to IR (only 5 games career); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
Davante Adams 142 routes sans Nacua as Ram, targeted 42%. Prior misses: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2. Projecting high usage again.
items.implication: Adams elite WR1 if Nacua out/doubtful.

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: High carries/goal-line vs weak run D.

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% TS both games; RB7 util (86); PIT 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.
LOVE Chris Olave (vs LV: 10+ tgts, high aDOT, LV allows 18.7 ypr), Christian Watson (vs ATL: WR8 util, 38% RZ), Dalton Schultz (@IND: 28% TS sans Collins, IND 4th TE yds).
items.why: Usage + matchups; Schultz boosted by Collins out.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne (vs LV: low util/snaps even w/ Kamara; 49% touches), Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches; tough D), Terry McLaurin (vs SEA: fewest WR pts allowed, low team total).
items.conflict: ETR has Etienne IN; Henderson snap notes positive but Berry ranks Stevenson ahead.
